text: welcome to this tutorial on building a RAG system
RAG stands for retrieval augmented generation
it combines a retrieval step with a language model
first you embed your documents into vectors
then when a user asks a question you find the most similar chunks
and pass them as context to the language model
this helps reduce hallucinations because the model has real data to reference
let me show you a concrete example using Python and FastAPI
we will use pgvector for storing embeddings in Postgres
and the OpenAI or Gemini API for generating embeddings and responses
the key benefit is that your answers are grounded in your own data
users can see exactly where the information came from via citations
thats why RAG is becoming the standard approach for knowledge-intensive applications
in the next section we will set up the database schema
thank you for watching and dont forget to subscribe
